messages:
mike: Kicking off observability provisioning for the new ap-south-1 GPU cluster. Need logs/metrics/traces + dashboards + standard alert templates. Primary constraints: limited egress, smaller S3 retention bucket in the region, and cost cap for first 30 days.

priya: +1. Do we want full-cardinality traces initially or just sampled spans?

ben: Let's start with 1% traces and tail-sample errors. We can increase if we see lots of unknown failures.

carla: For logs: ship application logs + kube-system. Use Vector to forward to regional S3 then to central observability replica. Must enable gzip and set 7-day hot retention, 30-day cold, per compliance ask.

anna: For metrics, plan is Prometheus federated: node/host exporter + kube-state + cAdvisor. Scrape interval 15s for autoscaling and 60s for infra metrics. Add relabeling to drop high-cardinality labels (pod_ip, pod_id).

raj: Network note: ap-south-1 has port 9000 blocked outbound to central collector. Need VPC peering + NAT rule or use the local regional collector. I'd prefer regional collector to avoid cross-region bandwidth.

mike: Good call. Runbook decision: provision regional observability collector stack (Prometheus + Thanos sidecar + Vector + Tempo) in ap-south-1. Thanos will upload compacted blocks to regional S3, replication to central on a schedule.

priya: Handoff checklist draft: 
- Terraform module applied for obs-stack-ap-south1 (prom, thanos, vector, tempo)
- IAM roles + KMS keys created and validated
- Bucket lifecycle policy created (7d hot -> 30d cold -> archive)
- Grafana folder + dashboards imported via API
- Alerting rules deployed to Alertmanager with silence windows
- Run smoke tests (metrics scrape, sample trace, log ingest)

ben: Adding templated alert rules we should include:
- High scrape error rate (>5% for 5m)
- Node GPU memory pressure >85% (5m)
- Pod restarts > 3 in 10m
- Thanos sidecar upload failures > 3 in 5m
- Vector buffer_full or write errors

carla: Quick snippet for Prometheus relabeling to remove pod_ip: 
```yaml
- action: replace
  source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_ip]
  target_label: pod_ip
- action: drop
  regex: .+
  source_labels: [pod_ip]
```
(then remove pod_ip from metrics-backed recording rules)

anna: For dashboards, we'll import the standard gpu-cluster overview + pod-health + thanos-objstore usage. Use grafana provisioning via TF so it's reproducible.

raj: infra-bot: deploy plan for obs-stack-ap-south1 finished: https://ci.redwood.internal/plan/8421 :warning: (note: plan includes smaller instance sizes to keep cost under $4k/mo during trial)

infra-bot: deployment pipeline started for obs-stack-ap-south1 (pipeline id 5482). Will post status updates.

mike: Validation steps after apply (short):
1) Prometheus targets up (curl http://prometheus-ap-south1:9090/-/ready)
2) Check thanos sidecar uploads (thanos_sidecar_last_successful_upload > unix_timestamp - 600)
3) Vector ingest count > 0 for each namespace (vector_metrics_events_total)
4) Tempo can retrieve a trace for a synthetic request (trace id returned in curl)
5) Grafana import shows GPU dashboard with node metrics populated

ben: Cost mitigation tips: set Prometheus retention to 7d locally, use Thanos downsampled rules for 30d and longer, and enforce relabeling to drop pod_name for high-cardinality metrics. Also enable compaction schedule to off-peak hours.

priya: After smoke pass, I'll run the canary load generator for 2 hours and collect SLO metrics. We'll verify alert thresholds and tweak.

carla: Also ensure log schema normalization in Vector to strip PII and reduce event size. Example transform: extract timestamp, level, message, service, gpu_id.

mike: Handoff to infra-oncall: please follow the runbook link and mark the cluster 'obs-ready' in inventory. Runbook: https://docs.redwood.internal/runbooks/obs-ap-south1-bootstrap.md

raj: infra-bot: smoke test result: metrics ok, logs flowing, traces sampled. One Thanos upload error (S3 403) — likely IAM perms.

mike: Assigning to carla for S3/KMS perms check.

carla: Found missing kms:Encrypt permission on the role used by Thanos. Patching policy now. Will redeploy sidecar config.

infra-bot: patch applied to role obs-thanos-uploader-ap-south1. Redeploying sidecars (rolling restart).

ben: After restart, sidecar uploads show success. All green on the dashboard.

mike: Final notes for handoff message to oncall: include pointers to rollback (disable sidecar uploads, switch traffic to central collector via tg), cost dashboard link, and contact list. I'll draft and post in #eng-oncall. :tada:

priya: Nice work team. I'll capture this thread into the runbook and add the alert templates to our central repo.

mike: Closing the bootstrap thread. Will leave infra-bot summary and runbook PR link once I finish write-up.
